task: Assign the overcharge ticket for mossgate-hq, then write the ticket summary file with the people involved, the amounts at stake and the goodwill voucher issued.
rationale: The artifact is the summary a support lead attaches to a billing ticket: who raised it and who handled it, when it was raised and last touched, what the customer was charged against what they owed, and the voucher code sent by way of apology. Routing the ticket to an agent, filing the summary as an attachment, and house rules for dates, money amounts, initials and voucher codes all belong to one piece of ticket handling. The five assignment tools are identical stubs that hand the same ticket to an agent, the five attachment slots are opaque codes, and the task supplies people, amounts and a voucher for every rule to act on without choosing any convention; each group's members are tokens a writer adds only on purpose, so a summary that ignores both reads as neither.
